newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy third mobile phone licence by mid-December.
newsitem.headline: Italy third mobile phone licence by mid-December.

text.p: The competition to apply for Italy's third mobile phone network will start towards the middle of July and the licence will be awarded between the end of November and the middle of December, Italy's undersecretary at the Posts Ministry Michele Lauria said on Tuesday.
Lauria was speaking as he entered parliament's upper house Senate Transport Commission.

Two groupings are preparing to bid for the third licence. First, a venture between Italian electricity utility ENEL and Deutsche Telekom and a second consortium consisting of Italian media group Mediaset and British Telecom.
